notes.title: Update #36 - New Editor Objects, Contest, Development News
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/e1db85cc37f6377e573beb0ae05ad73e40d14a41.png

New Editor objects!  

What is new?

Added terraforming events to the Editor - change water and ground levels on a timer, after a city quest completion or when delivering anything to a station!  Here is our Editor terraforming guide. 

What is fixed?


 Minor bugfixes.


Time-limited contest!

With the introduction of new mechanics to the Editor we announce the start of a new level-design competition starting September 1st — Terraforming Level Of The Month:


 Learn and implement new Activable objects and Scenarios in your levels
 Submit your creations to Train Valley 2 Workshop 
 Three levels will be awarded Steam Wallet funds prizes at the end of September
 Levels without new mechanics will be reviewed and awarded separately on a weekly basis


Game publishing related developments.

Our friends META Publishing having previously assisted with many under-the-hood processes for Flazm Interactive project Time Loader have recently offered a helping hand with Train Valley games — and we have come to an agreement to join our efforts.
What does that mean for our community? This cooperation changes little for our players - LPT contests, weekly and monthly level reviews, more upcoming content for Train Valley 2 will arrive right on schedule :)

We are looking forward to your feedback and hopefully very few bug reports :) See you in a bit, friends!

notes.title: Let's Play Together - Train Fortress 2: 2Fort (UPDATE 2.0)
notes.notes:
Hello friends! Every Friday 17:30 UTC/GMT we hold a “Let’s play together” competition. During next 24 hours everyone is welcome to try and score the best time in a preselected level. Join our Discord server and keep Discord running while playing — your results will be automatically published in the #lets-play-together channel. You need to get 5 stars to qualify.

Glittering prizes include:
1) Top 3 winners receive one random card each. Collect 18 locomotive cards and advance to next set of 6 all new cards! Complete that second set and enter a final tier of 2 very special and super limited cards! Assemble 26 cards and receive a special prize. Easy!
2) Every player registered by our Discord bot has a chance to get a card. The number of cards depends on the number of participants: one additional card for every 10 train connoisseurs on the list. More players means more prizes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/44261df2370db964e169632044b0f681393f96fb.jpg
Visit our Discord server (#lets-play-together channel) to learn more.

A level we are playing this week is 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2455613719
Just open the game - there's a link right in the main menu.

Good luck everyone!

notes.title: Update #34 - Bugfixes and QoL improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/6b76e70a696a6c50e539a8075b60132f5dbe5b7d.png

Greetings! It's been quite some time since we last brought you an update, or so we've been told :) Without further adieu:

What is new?


 Added a Universal Factory production building to the editor - looks more industrial-ish, does the same thing as Alchemical Lab!
 A new way to delete tracks and nothing else but tracks by holding Shift button and clicking left mouse button.
 Stopping a train will now only count when it stops completely — meaning you have a very small window to change your mind and not fail a Do Not Stop Any Trains challenge.
 You can now delete a bridge while having negative funds.
 Both Customs and Power Plant now have a stock counter.


What was fixed?


 Store icons are no longer highlighted in green colour randomly.
 Fixed inability to complete a level if the last coloured train goes anywhere except a coloured station.
 And other minor fixes.


We are always looking forward to your feedback and bug reports. See you in a bit, friends!

notes.title: Update #33 - Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
Hello friends! We hope you've seen our big update and new Alchemy Lab by now. We've made another update. Now there will be fewer bugs.

What is fixed?

Now colored trains can be resources. They can be assigned to the market, store, harbors, and Alchemy Lab.
If earlier the required resource for the city had to be indicated in the first line of quests, now it is not necessary. If out of the three selected resources you decide to leave only the second or third, then it is enough to put zero opposite the first.
Incorrect joining of two bridges on the same cell.
Incorrect branching of the end track tile at the customs.


As usual, we appreciate your feedback and bug reports. See you, friends!

notes.title: Update #32 - Alchemical Lab
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/1b333714ff93102af5603d017dc3e140d7df7b35.png
Hello friends! Six months have passed since the last major innovation in our game. Isn't it the time for us to give you something new? We believe the time has come! In the October update, you will find new objects in the level editor: a new section with Halloween objects, new resources, a new harbor design, and also our main novelty ‒ the Alchemical Lab!

This is a new type of factory for which you can set all the parameters yourself. You can select up to 5 different required resources and define any end product. Why not make a yellow potion from pumpkin, gold ore, glass, dynamite and old tire in a witch's cauldron? Easy! Your experiments can go as far as you want.

What is new?

Alchemical Lab object in Level Editor.
New resources: Bat, Spider, Pumpkin and six Potions. You can use them in Harbors, Market and Store, as usual.
New special “Harbor Old” design ‒ “Harbor Halloween”.
42 new Halloween objects.


What is fixed?

Now the workshop level that you started from the main menu is included in the recently played list.
You can now return to the game from the in-game menu with Esc.


We would be glad if you let us know about any issues related to this update. We hope you enjoy all of these new items! Stay tuned, friends.

notes.title: Update #31 - Gamepad Support
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/277c5b17b8a3412493778209ae11742b314236a9.png
Hello friends! I hope you are well! We have great news. We used to think that train games are keyboard and mouse only. So if you like train management games please play them at the table and even thing about couch gaming. We are here to break this stereotype and introduce you to full gamepad support for Train Valley 2. Maybe it will seem a bit strange at the beginning, but probably after 5 minutes, it will be your favorite way to play the game! What I can say for sure: it is much easier to build tracks with a gamepad! Try it out! There is no special gamepad tutorial yet, but you should easily get the idea of the control scheme from the hints.

What is added?
- Full Gamepad support (Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS4, PS3, and many many others)
- Timings and challenges added to workshop levels description.

What is fixed?
- Wrong hint for Embargo station.
-  Scroll added for workshop level description in the game browser. The font size stays the same. 
- Unity engine updated to the last version (more optimized and stable).

Please share the feedback about your gamepad user experience and in case you face any bugs or problems. We are here to help as always!
Stay tuned and be safe! ːtvmachinistː

UPD: If you experience problems with the keyboard or mouse controls you can always choose "previous_stable" build in BETA section (right-click on the game in Steam library > Properties > BETA).

notes.title: Update #29 - Embargo Station
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/41ceeb0245e9bb902c40cee2b17a9163b4adc719.png Hello friends! Hope you and your family are safe. We have prepared something really interesting for you with this update. Ladies and gentlemen, please meet Embargo Station. This new level editor object has very simple mechanics. It allows all the goods to come through except one (you can set it in level editor settings). This is a flexible and powerful mechanics offering a lot of interesting situations. We want to thank @Yokuyin from our community for offering this great idea! And we are looking forward to seeing what you guys can create with the new Embargo Station!

APRIL LEVEL DESIGN CONTEST - EMBARGO STATION
We are adding extra prizes and a theme of our level design contest in April. Create a workshop level with Embargo Station during the April and win a 30€, 20€ or 10€ Steam card! No jokes!
 
We have also finished some long-awaited in-game browser functionality making easier to find the best workshop levels among >800 of them. Full list of changes:

What is new?
- Embargo Station object in Level Editor.
- Sorting by Author option in workshop in-game browser.
- "Recently Played First" sorting option (will work only after this update, but definitely help you later)
- Autosave in the level editor (will carefully save your work every minute).
- Discord button near the active let's-play-together level in the main menu. Now it's easier to participate in the contest and join our warm discord community).

What is fixed? 
- A bug allowed tracks to be built across the one-way station object.
- A bug with missing tracks on the one-way station entrance.
- Interface scale problem in the main menu.

Please let us know if something goes wrong with this update. We are here to help!
Don't forget to create great levels (just try if you never did) and participate in our let-play-together events. Now we have two of them every week!
Stay tuned! Choo-choo!

Try to play with our new workshop object called "One Way Station". You can find it in Level Editor in "Stations" folder. It is a simple yet powerful element, that allows trains to go only one direction. We believe that this object can help to build a lot of interesting situations and can dramatically change the rules of gameplay. So let it be a theme of February level design contest. Build a level with "One way station" and upload it to the Workshop till the end of February. 3 best levels will get a prizes from our team!

notes.title: Update #21 - Main Menu Featuring
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28520888/49495a7cb1f14d980004c3c3543645c5ee0be910.png Hello everyone! We took a pause after the release to rest a bit, but now we are full of ideas are ready to move on. This update is dedicated to the main menu featuring. We've realized that a lot of players are not aware of TV2 workshop content and our events. So we decided to make a special featuring section in the main menu to show there next Let's play together event countdown, links to Weekly/Monthly contests rules and other activities. Hope it will help to keep you (our players) updated about our recent news even if you are not following the game on Steam community hub. Here is the full list of changes:

Features added:
- Workshop levels featuring on the main menu screen (maps are chosen among high rated workshop content that wasn't played yet).
- Custom events featuring on the main menu screen. We want more players to know about our Let's play together event and Level Design contests.
- Small fixes in campaign levels.
- Improved search in workshop browser inside the game.

Bugs fixed:
- Workshop. Published levels are not shown in my levels tab.
- Car with cattle was drowned a bit below the surface.
- After dropping of progress custom locomotives should be dropped as well.
- Delayed achievement after completing the main campaign.

https://media.giphy.com/media/h541ByoufCwvquIB2O/source.gif Attention, all passengers! Train Valley 2 is about to depart from the Puzzle & Tycoon Station. Get on board! We are happy to announce that, after a successful trip through Early Access lands, Train Valley 2 is going to full release on Steam! To celebrate the release, we offer a -10% launch discount for a limited time.
Disclaimer: due to Steam rules we can't change early access status until Monday, but full release version is already available!

The full version brings tons of new content:

 20 brand new levels (50 campaign levels in total)
 Over 45 production buildings and raw materials
 Up to 18 locomotives from the steam era to the future (inspired by real ones)
 New interactive mechanics and special events such as fog, earthquakes, volcanoes, long trains and launching rockets!
 Almost 500 user-made levels already available in Steam Workshop

Do you want more? Grab the game's original soundtrack with a 10% launch discount to support our team and keep humming those lovely tunes on your daily commute:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056730/Train_Valley_2__Original_Soundtrack/

Friends, the full release is just the beginning of our journey! Every week we are waiting for you on our lets-play-together events! notes.title: Update #9
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28520888/5850d7ef6d0546fbc77623fd39588db7b94df469.pngGreetings fellow train lovers! Here comes our new update – and this time we have prepared something really special for you! First of all, we have implemented some important changes in Leaderboards. Now Global rank is not that intrusive, and you can just ignore it if you prefer. But if you do care about it, we have 2 more parameters to compete for: Funds (money earned in a particular level) and Real Time (real-life time you spent playing that level, considering downtime during pauses and 2x/4x game speed). Also, we added some nice charts with histograms showing the total number of results and your position. That should also make the balancing of workshop level times easier for its authors.
 
The second big thing is a new feature in the Level Editor called Store Production. It sends trains automatically every N seconds. These trains do not require your resources or workers, not even your locomotives – you just get an additional train to deliver and earn money out of it (check the new Workshop guide video for more details). This feature is pretty much inspired by the gameplay of the original Train Valley, and it can help you to set the pace of your levels. To illustrate how it works, we present to you our new workshop level called Canal. And we want you to experiment with this mechanics as well, so today we announce a new Levels Contest! The rules are simple: make a new level using Store Production as a part of gameplay. The most creative, beautiful, and polished levels will get great prizes: Train Valley 2 merchandise and Steam codes! 
 
Check the list below for the full patch notes. Choo-choo!
 
Features added:
 
- New Leaderboards screen with histograms and additional parameters
- Your global rank level is hidden on the Levels map. Rank button opens leaderboards screen
- New "Store" production automatically sending trains.
- Some new objects added in level editor.
 
Bugs fixed:

Stay tuned! :tv2conductor:

Hello fellows! Here is our first update in Early Access! We have tried to fix the most critical bugs and add most required features.

- Tutorial pop-up on level5 is half out of the screen.
- Mouse wheel default direction inverted (Zoom/menu scrolling).
- Auto switch-off of building mode.
- Stars for crashing trains on purpose and other "negative" objectives removed.
- Glitching sound of rails building. 
- Train sounds on pause.
- Bug with getting the time bonus on exact second.
- Trains moving close to each another can crash on slopes, curves or stations entrances.
- Bug with a tracks segment on level 16 on the top of the tunnel.
- District requirements tooltips were not localised.
- Glitching bankruptcy state.
- Format of numbers in objective tooltips.
- ESC button should leads to the previous screen.
- FPS widget is turned off.

What's new:
- Turkish language.
- A part of the planning tracks highlights with red if you don't have enough money.
- Show production/station capacity (4/10).
- Special track for main menu added.
- Now trains with different number of cars have equal maximum speed but different acceleration.
- Price for the locomotive repair is 2x cheaper.
- More objects/obstacles added on levels 4, 7, 19.
- Popping up message "Not enough funds".
- Show time for stars on level completed window.

If you face some critical issues after this patch please download previous_stable  build in BETA section and let us know.
Our next update is going to be in 2 weeks. If you find any bugs or you have new ideas how to improve the game please let us know on steam forums (but first check our actual to-do list).
